mainEntity.name: Why does immigration law compliance matter at the compliance stage?

acceptedAnswer.text: It matters because immigration matters do not end at approval, because status maintenance, registrations, updates, and later duties can shape what happens next. Before the next step, immigration law compliance usually has to be checked for delay, inconsistency, and procedural risk as much as for the legal rule itself.
